```{=html}
<script>
// Quarto's grid-listing category widget renders into the margin sidebar
// and lists every category. The design wants it inline above the grid,
// directly under the search box, and trimmed to "All" plus the 7
// most-used categories. Quarto's own listing/filter setup runs on
// DOMContentLoaded and can rebuild the sidebar after a naive one-shot
// move, so this watches for the widget and re-applies whenever it
// (re)appears.
(function() {
  // Quarto renders each category as a plain <div onclick>, which a
  // keyboard or screen-reader user can't reach at all. Make each one a
  // real button-like control instead.
  function makeKeyboardAccessible(el) {
    if (el.dataset.a11yBound) return;
    el.dataset.a11yBound = 'true';
    el.setAttribute('role', 'button');
    el.setAttribute('tabindex', '0');
    el.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
      if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') {
        e.preventDefault();
        el.click();
      }
    });
  }

  function trimToTopCategories(cats, max) {
    var items = Array.from(cats.querySelectorAll('.category'));
    items.forEach(makeKeyboardAccessible);
    var all = items.find(function(el) { return el.dataset.category === ''; });
    // "All" reads as the active filter until the user picks something
    // else — Quarto doesn't mark it active on load by default.
    if (all && !items.some(function(el) { return el.classList.contains('active'); })) {
      all.classList.add('active');
    }
    var rest = items.filter(function(el) { return el !== all; });
    // Sort by post count descending (most-used categories first, matching
    // the design), falling back to alphabetical for ties.
    rest.sort(function(a, b) {
      var ca = parseInt((a.querySelector('.quarto-category-count') || {}).textContent.replace(/\D/g, ''), 10) || 0;
      var cb = parseInt((b.querySelector('.quarto-category-count') || {}).textContent.replace(/\D/g, ''), 10) || 0;
      if (cb !== ca) return cb - ca;
      return a.textContent.localeCompare(b.textContent);
    });
    rest.forEach(function(el, i) { el.style.display = i < max ? '' : 'none'; });
    // Quarto's widget only lets us hide the trimmed-out categories in
    // place — it doesn't order them by count. Physically reorder the DOM
    // nodes so the visible chips actually read in count order too.
    var frag = document.createDocumentFragment();
    rest.forEach(function(el) { frag.appendChild(el); });
    cats.appendChild(frag);
  }

  function relocate() {
    var cats = document.querySelector('.quarto-listing-category');
    var actions = document.querySelector('#listing-all-posts .listing-actions-group');
    if (!cats || !actions) return false;
    trimToTopCategories(cats, 7);
    if (cats.previousElementSibling !== actions) {
      actions.parentElement.insertBefore(cats, actions.nextSibling);
      return true;
    }
    return false;
  }

  if (!relocate()) {
    var tries = 0;
    var timer = setInterval(function() {
      tries += 1;
      if (relocate() || tries > 40) clearInterval(timer);
    }, 50);
  }
  var sidebar = document.querySelector('#quarto-margin-sidebar');
  if (sidebar) {
    new MutationObserver(relocate).observe(sidebar, { childList: true });
  }

  // "{n} POSTS" count label, left-justified below the category chips,
  // updated as filters/search narrow the grid. Quarto's listing filter
  // (List.js) removes non-matching items from the grid's child list
  // rather than hiding them in place, so the live count is just the
  // grid's current child count, re-queried on every change.
  function initCount() {
    var listing = document.querySelector('#listing-all-posts');
    var cats = document.querySelector('.quarto-listing-category');
    var grid = listing && listing.querySelector('.list.grid');
    if (!listing || !cats || !grid) return false;
    var label = document.createElement('span');
    label.className = 'listing-count';
    cats.parentElement.insertBefore(label, cats.nextSibling);
    function update() {
      var n = grid.children.length;
      label.textContent = n + (n === 1 ? ' POST' : ' POSTS');
    }
    update();
    new MutationObserver(update).observe(grid, { childList: true });
    return true;
  }
  if (!initCount()) {
    var ctries = 0;
    var ctimer = setInterval(function() {
      ctries += 1;
      if (initCount() || ctries > 40) clearInterval(ctimer);
    }, 50);
  }
})();
</script>
```
